title: Study Assistant and Code Synchronization Platform
description: A high-performance educational platform featuring a full-completeness document ingestion pipeline, layered caching (Redis/in-memory), and a multi-step Gemini AI system for advanced note generation, context-aware chatting, and automated exam solving.

title: Travel Package Booking App
description: A mobile application built with Jetpack Compose and real-time data flow (Firestore snapshot listeners) across all features, complemented by a robust notification scheduling system (WorkManager) and an integrated AI assistant (Gemini API).

title: Airport Flight Network Routing System
description: A data-persistent flight network manager in Java, built around a core Map-based graph structure that supports full CRUD operations, with a BFS shortest-path solver and reliable data serialization using Gson.

title: Online Shopping System
description: A Java application with a dedicated service layer providing complete CRUD functionality across major entities, persistent data management via JSON serialization (Gson) and a dynamic, high-fidelity Swing UI (FlatLaf, MigLayout).

title: Musical Awards Management System
description: A highly modular C++ platform for event management, specializing in complex scheduling with strict conflict resolution, an atomic payment system (with a pending status and automated refunds), and real-time console visualization of attendance, sales, and venue seating capacity.

title: Personal Desktop Management Suite
description: A Python/Tkinter suite integrating three applications: an expense tracker with visual analytics, a reminder app with scheduled notifications and a dynamic clock, and a structured note organizer, all accessible via an animated main menu.
